name: Azumino (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Azumino city emblem in green and orange: a green stylised character of curved strokes with an orange ring.
history: Municipal flag of Azumino, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Azumino city emblem — a green stylised character of curved strokes with an orange ring
